description: Panther Creek is a thriving 169,588 square foot community shopping center strategically located in The Woodlands, Texas, one of the nation's premier master-planned communities. Anchored by Sprouts Farmers Market and featuring key tenants including Planet Fitness, Woodlands Children's Museum, and CVS, the center serves as a vital neighborhood hub for the affluent surrounding community. With nearly 2 million annual visits, Panther Creek caters to a highly desirable demographic with average household incomes of $188,926 and home values exceeding $603,000 within a 3-mile radius. The center benefits from its location in a dynamic employment corridor with over 100,000 employees working within 5 miles, creating strong daytime traffic of 89,728 people. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, Panther Creek offers a carefully curated mix of grocery, health and wellness, family services, and convenience retail that perfectly aligns with the lifestyle needs of The Woodlands' discerning residents.
